english.title: Possess identity documents with intent - Identity Cards Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with the intention of

(A)_[using an identity document for establishing registrable facts about yourself]_
(B)_[allowing or inducing another to use an identity document for establishing, ascertaining or verifying registrable facts about yourself or about any other person]_

had in your possession or under your control such a document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), that

(C)_[was false and that you knew or believed to be false]_
(D)_[was improperly obtained and that you knew or believed to have been improperly obtained]_
(E)_[related to someone else]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 25(1), (2) and (6) of the Identity Cards Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
with the intent to
use an identity document for establishing registrable facts about yourself OR
allow/induce another to use an identity document for
establishing/ascertaining/verifying registrable facts about yourself/another
had in your possession/under your control such a document
that was false and that you knew/believed to be false OR
that was improperly obtained and that you knew/believed to have been improperly obtained OR
that related to someone else

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) For the current legislation, please see the Identity Documents Act 2010.(ii) Option E excepts the case of a document of the individual to whom it relates. (Section 25(2)(b)).

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Meddu ar ddogfennau adnabod gan fwriadu - Deddf Cardiau Adnabod 2006
